summary: All iteration 12 follow-ups are verified. (1) HIGH fixed: e38e91c9 is now in EXPO_PUBLIC_EXTRA_API_HOSTS. I pasted the e38e91c9 /api/open link on the home screen at 390x844 and every /api request went to e38e91c9, which serves the LOCAL backend (45 m zones, ride routes). Start ride, entering the pickup zone (zone timer shown), leaving about 100 m out (zone timer gone, departed_source=geofence) and End ride (ride.ended_at set) all worked. Reopening /d/<token> without the api param reused the remembered e38e91c9 host, and the ended ride persisted ('Tracking finished', no pings sent while inside the delivery zone). The remote naughty-hugle-13 TEST-0001 was read only (GET) and is unchanged. (2) update_load re-applies the radius only when it changed: an unchanged save keeps the per-stop tweak [80, 200], a changed value applies to all stops, and an invalid change returns 400 with the stored value kept. (3) create_load with radius 5 returns 400 and writes no facilities; the default is 45. (4) A ping with accuracy 0 is stored as 0 (no arrival 50 m out); a missing accuracy is stored as 50. (5) After the ride ends, a ping inside the zone is stored with stop_id=None and triggers no event or arrival. (6) The 45 m fallbacks are in FacilityMap.tsx, [token].tsx, pdfgen.py and Evidence.js, the LoadDetail slider max is 3000, and no '300' radius fallbacks remain. Backend suite run with -n 0: 90/93 passed. The 3 failures are in test_driver_emails and are caused by the email provider returning 429 rate_limited, which I confirmed with a direct probe; they are not caused by this change. Local TEST-0001 was reset at the end.

minor.issue: Pings from driver taps are still stored with 'body.accuracy or 50', which turns accuracy 0 into 50. This does not match the driver_ping fix. server.py:1247

The changed radius is validated (_apply_radius) only after build_stops, which may already have called upsert_facility for new or moved stops. An invalid radius then returns 400 but leaves facility writes behind, the same problem that was fixed in create_load. server.py:567-570
Demo loads store geofence_radius_m=None, so the first save that sends 45 counts as a change and overwrites any per-stop radius tweaks. Compare against (stored or DEFAULT_RADIUS). server.py:569

The 'Email provider is busy (rate limited)' message never shows. emailer.py raises a generic 'Failed to send email' on a 429, so the check for '429' in the message at server.py:684 never matches. 3 tests in test_driver_emails fail because the external provider currently returns 429.

action_items: LOW: Use the same accuracy-None check in driver_action as in driver_ping (server.py:1247).
LOW: In update_load, validate geofence_radius_m before build_stops.
LOW: In update_load, compare against (load.geofence_radius_m or DEFAULT_RADIUS) so a demo load with None does not overwrite per-stop radii on the first save.
LOW: Have emailer pass the 429 or rate-limit info into EmailError so the friendly 'rate limited' message works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1873 lines; consider splitting the driver, loads and email routes into modules.

success_rate.backend: 15/15 new tests pass; full suite 90/93 run with -n 0 (3 email tests fail on the provider's 429 rate limit, not on this change)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the e38e91c9 link flow: requests went to the trusted host, and start, zone in/out and end ride work against the LOCAL backend
